subject: [hw] DONE V03 rev 3 (real V02 core, iOS compile)
body:
Rev 3 (V02 DONE at 12:24; no loader interface/semantic change since rev 2):
1) The unresolved-import contract is now the real one, verified end-to-end: n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, name) is
   accepted by V02's DONE core; entering each slot stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT, stop_addr is the slot and
   n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr) gives the import name. n2elf.c's defensive fallback is now dead code with V02.
2) run_tests.sh has a new mandatory section "V03 against V02's real interpreter" (t_real.c): it uses V02's real
   n2a32_mem/core/run/call and the real A32/T16 class files. It checks the synthetic set links with unresolved=2,
   both NOIMPORT stops + names, n2elf_run_init executes the whole init chain (5 markers set, RETURN), liba_fn(5)
   returns 5+0x11223344, libarm_fn(5) returns 0x22446694 through the loader's GOT/PLT + a host-call shim, and the
   five vendor objects link with unresolved=146. The introspection suite (permissions, call order) still uses the
   test double because n2a32.h has no permission/call-log accessor.
3) arm64-apple-ios16.5 compile check added (compile only, both files, -Werror, SDK V30 uses): 2/2.
4) New fixture libarm (ARM, built against liba, GOT/PLT + shim calls), oracle-checked and used by t_real.

Last line now:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V03 PASS 12964/12964
Sections: 12868 oracle checks per build (ASan+UBSan, -O2), 33 real-emulator checks per build, 61 relocation-encoding
unit checks, 2 iOS compile checks. Vendor line unchanged: objects 5, relocations 3120, unresolved 146, unique
imports 149; per object vpud 91/91, libvpud_vcodec 191/191, libvcodecdrv 2162/2162, utility 498/498, oal 178/178.

External evidence now includes hw-t01 (97-kernel differential set, unresolved=0, all symbols found) and hw-v30's
V30-E2E 9/9 (real ARM guest with compiler varargs/qsort/malloc through this loader + V02 core).

Not done unchanged: RELA/TLS/IFUNC/COPY/GNU_RELRO/unload/FINI execution; loader setup is single-threaded; FINI arrays
parsed but no fini API; NEEDED not loaded is ignored; no phone run; STATUS updated in dsh-state/workers/V03/ and
loader/test_v03/.
